- Tue 11/03: 10:00–11:00 PT or 15:00–15:45 PT
- Wed 11/04: 08:30–09:15 PT or 13:00–13:45 PT

Attendees will be me (project sponsor), Jared Cole (PM), and two engineering leads — I attached the stakeholder roster. Please confirm which slot works and who from Redwood will facilitate and provide the Zoom bridge.

- 5m intro & success criteria
- 10m stakeholder intros and roles
- 15m implementation timeline highlights (owners + blockers)
- 10m access & provisioning plan (SSO, data access)
- 5m next steps and immediate actions
